WRITING




 中间段落由关联词+分论点+分论点的论证构成分论点和分论点的论证之间可能有关联词。

WRITING


1 顺接(一边倒的内部)

 2. While it is undeniable that studying abroad is beneficial, it

WRITING：MEANS OF ARGUMENTATION
 论证手段


 4. 举例论证1. 扩展主题句
 （基本句型） (单个例子，例子排比）

2. 假设论证 5. 对比论证

论证方法：
 同一段可以使用多个论证手段但是：
 不是说每一段都得使用到这几种，将论证方法分散到你的论据中，不要成了填空式作文。

1. 扩展主题句：

A: 同义替换
1. in other words换言之
2. that is to say也就是说
3. to be more precise说的具体一些
4. by … I mean 我的意思是
5. this means…这意味着
6. namely

1. 扩展主题句：

B: 主题句中的名词讲清楚---抽象名词具体化

 The cost of living has been steadily rising in
 the past decades.

 Food prices, clothing costs, housing expenses,
 and tuition fees annually increased by 5.59%
 over the period of 1995 to 2008.

Initially, one issue makes me support this is that
(1topic sentence) the development of science and
technology has always accompanied the progress
of society.

 (1 details).The invention of the steam engine led
to the industrial revolution and brought about a
new era of thrift of world economy. The
employment of electricity has multiplied the
productivity and reproduced the limited energy
on earth. The innovation of computer technology
resulted in the information age and connected the
distant countries as a single market（a global
village).(3 details).

Some people think that teachers should be
 responsible for teaching students how to judge
 right and wrong and how to behave well. Some
 say that teachers should only teach students
 about academic subjects. Discuss both views
 and give your opinion.

1. For one thing, offering academic
 knowledge can contribute to students’
 achievement.

2. For another, at the community level,
 education institutions, obviously, should
 shoulder the responsibility to cultivate
 qualified citizens.

TS:
 For one thing, offering academic knowledge can
 contribute to students’ achievement.

使用拓展主题句方法展开：
 That is to say, in primary school, children should be
 instilled（灌输）the ability of spell Chinese
 characters and basic mathematical knowledge which
 ensure them mastering the common sense in daily
 life and offering the first step of further education.

2. 假设说明思路：通过假设得出了一系列的可怕的后果，最后再得出结论，这样的结论是发人深省，当然也是最能引起人们广泛重视的，这样的雅思大作文写作方法是最容易给人留下深刻印象的。

条件状语从句或目的状语从句

• Then, since the transportation system is the lifeline
 of a country’s economic activities, its paralysis would
 lead to the disintegration of the economy, either
 industry of farming or daily life. Suppose all the
 means of transportation were halted for lack of oil,
 factories with insufficient raw materials would have
 to close, workers would be out of work, and ripe
 farm crops would have to stay in the fields at the
 mercy of rain and storms. People would try to store
 food and the price of all commodities would go up. If
 we take those power stations run by oil into account,
 situations would become even worse. In this sense,
 oil decides the fate of the whole economy and that
 of the government.

WRITING

 3. 延长因果链
 The most immediate factor that has given rose to
 this phenomenon is the extensive use of farming
 machinery. Such as seeding, harvesting and grain-
 dying machines, in the process of the modernization
 of agricultural production, which has, in turn freed
 more farmers form the land to seek better
 opportunities in cities. With more immigrant
 workers swarming into them, many cities have been
 forced to expand into the neighboring countryside,
 as to accommodate the swelling population.

TS:
 For one thing, offering academic knowledge
 can contribute to students’ achievement.
使用拓展主题句方法展开：
 In primary school, children should be instilled
 the ability of spelling Chinese letters and basic
 mathematical knowledge which ensure them
 mastering the common sense in daily life. When
 students have a good command of academic
 subjects, such as, …they can obtain the priority
 to further education. If they fail to master those
 knowledge, it is difficult to seek a bright future.

WRITING

4. 举例论证

1)分论点体现在具体的人、事物和场合上（注意内部逻辑）

 Rather than limiting man’s imagination,
 the general application of modern
 technologies actually enables man to be
 more and more creative. For instance,
 Dream Works, the famous American film
 company, has been designing and producing
 cartons using computer technology. (3D
 technology)

WRITING



 For example, Michelangelo would not have
 become distinguished painter if he had spent
 his days doodling. Another illustration is that
 Mozart would not have grown up to be an
 accomplished musician at the age of 8 if he had
 stayed in front of television. Like Marie Curie
 and Helen Keller, they responded to the
 challenges of lives actively by disciplined
 trainings, and then they gained a new freedom
 of their lives. (3 examples).

举例子
1. I can think of no better illustration of this idea
 than the fact that more and more young people are
 finding it easier to get jobs.


2. A good case in point is Wuhan, which has a pedestrian
 shopping street.

3. Take my father as an example.

4. to illustrate, as an illustration

TS:
 It is the essential responsibility for teachers to convey
 academic subjects to learners.

使用拓展主题句方法展开：
 In primary school, children should be instilled the ability
 of spelling Chinese letters and basic mathematical
 knowledge which ensure them mastering the common
 sense in daily life. When students have a good command of
 academic subjects, such as, …they can obtain the priority
 to further education. If they fail to master those
 knowledge, it is difficult to seek a bright future. For
 instance, if a student fail to perform well in passing math,
 English, physics, and literature, he or she will be doomed to
 gain a failure in entering into university which can offer a
 diploma, thus, students will be handicapped by lack of
 required academic knowledge.

5、对比论证Comparison and contrast



 A：具体情况反对对比

 B: 过去和现在的对比

Should young adults want independence from
their parents as soon as possible?


TS:
 At the contemporary society, moral
guidance should be offered by parents to
ensure those young fellows to refrain from
misleading by inappropriate materials.

第一句：如果年轻人没有适当的保护直接面对社会上所有的诱惑，他们就会比和父母生活在一起的同龄人更有可能走上犯罪道路。


 If young adults are exposed without proper
protection from their parents to all the temptations and
evils of society, they are more likely to fall into a life of
crime than people of the same age who still live with
their parents.

第二句：转折相反，对于那些依然和父母生活的年轻人来说，
他们会知道当他们有困难的时候该怎么做。


 Conversely, for those who still stay with their
families, they might be informed of correct ways
when they are in trouble.

TS:
 For one thing, offering academic knowledge can contribute
 to students’ achievement.
使用拓展主题句方法展开：
 In primary school, children should be instilled the ability of
 spelling Chinese letters and basic mathematical knowledge
 which ensure them mastering the common sense in daily life.
 When students have a good command of academic subjects,
 such as, …they can obtain the priority to further education. If
 they fail to master those knowledge, it is difficult to seek a
 bright future. For instance, if a student fail to perform well in
 passing math, English, physics, and literature, he or she will be
 doomed to gain a failure in entering into university which can
 offer a diploma, thus, students will be handicapped by lack of
 required academic knowledge. In the past, the development of
 society was not as rapid as that in present, it is unnecessary to
 be equipped with a large quantity of knowledge. However,
 nowadays, driven by scientific and technological breakthroughs,
 only when students own as much knowledge as others
 domestic and abroad, can they become more competitive,
 which is also the basic obligation of teachers in current
 situation of China.

WRITING：TASK II




 6. 什么叫做驳论？

WRITING：TASK II




 Some people hold that…(反方观点)，
 because…(反方的简单论据). However, they are
 oversimplifying the situation. In fact…(反驳反方观点或者建立自己的观点）

WRITING：TASK II

 Task response（任务反应）

 What is your opinion about nuclear technologies?

 In fact, the nuclear technology is more a curse
 than a blessing for society.

 As an energy provider, the nuclear technology would
 threaten or even destroy the environment if there were a
 technical accident, which is more often than not the case.

WRITING：TASK II


 Some people hold that…(反方观点)，because…(反方的简单论据). However, they are oversimplifying the
 situation. In fact…(反驳反方观点或者建立自己的观点）

 Some people assert that the nuclear technology, as an
 energy provider, is beneficial for society, because it can
 create cheap and clean energy. However, they are
 oversimplifying the situation. In fact, if there were a
 technical accident, which is more often than not the case,
 the outcome would be disastrous…

WRITING


• Some people may think/argue/insist that(反方观点）…,
 because…(反方观点的论据). However, they are
 oversimplifying the situation. In fact/As a matter of fact/in
 actuality, …(反驳反方观点或建立自己的观点）

• Eg: Some people think that the nuclear technology, as an
 energy provider, is beneficial for society, because it can create
 cheap and clean energy. However, they are oversimplifying the
 situation. In fact, if there were a technical accident, which is
 more often than not the case, the outcome would be
 disastrous.

WRITING


 Those who argue that …often build their reasoning on such
an assumption that.... This assumption, nevertheless, is
absurd/misleading.


 Those who argue that the nuclear technology, as an energy
provider, is beneficial for society often build their reasoning on
such an assumption that it can create cheap and clean energy.
This assumption, nevertheless, is absurd. In fact, if there were a
technical accident, which is more often than not the case, the
outcome would be disastrous.

WRITING
Those who argue that governments should not take the
responsibility to fund the development of arts often build their
reasoning on such an assumption that arts contribute little
to the improvement of human life. This
assumption/supposition/statement/assertion, nevertheless, is
absurd. As a matter of fact, the quality of human life is not only
measured by material gains but also by spiritual satisfaction.
Admittedly, the presence of buildings, highways, banks, or cargo
ships, airplanes, and the GDP increases do contribute to human
comforts and convenience. Yet, it cannot be denied that the
quality of human life involves broader aspects in addition to
material things. It includes, inevitably, the spiritual life, which can
never be improved merely by material gains. The spiritual
problems, or in other words, problems inherent in human soul,
perhaps can only be unlocked by arts. In this sense, governments
is certainly responsible for funding the art development for the
sake of the peace and tranquility in soul.
论据综合实例

WRITING


 1. People are optimistic about 21st
 century. Many people think it is a good
 opportunities to find positive change in
 future. How do you think the optimism?
 What would you like to change in 21st
 century?

WRITING

2) 对整个系统（世界经济）的影响：世界经济通过高效通讯提高效率


 Information technologies has greatly improved the
 efficiency of communication and therefore stimulated the
 world economy.

 (Examples can be easily found to support this viewpoint.
 Before the Internet has been widely established, a
 businessman in Beijing had to fly to London to make a
 bargain with his partners, taking him more than three
 days to settle down and begin to negotiate. On the other
 hand, via the Internet, he only needs to open Net meeting
 system now, which allows him to exchange ideas with his
 partners virtually and simultaneously through not only
 audio but also video information.)

WRITING
2) 对整个系统（世界经济）的影响：男女平等
 In addition, an information society furthers more
 profound influence on social structure.
 In fact, the advent(coming) of new
 technologies has made it possible for women to
 share equal status with men. In the past, namely
 the industrial or agricultural era, physical power
 was the most essential element of productivity,
 and obviously females were not as strong as males.
 However, the information era now attaches more
 importance to intelligence rather than physical
 power, and there is no evidence indicating that
 women are not as intelligent as men. As a result,
 increasingly more females have occupied
 significant social positions, such as the CEO, the
 Prime Minister and the President.

WRITING

5.反驳：反驳全球化对世界经济带来好处

 Quite a few people are optimistic that the
 prospect of cultural and economic globalization,
 which is another characteristic in the 21st
 century, might bring more opportunities for the
 world economy. However, it is more a curse
 than a blessing for developing countries.
 Due to the globalization, wealthy countries are
 much easier to seize cheap natural and labor
 resources in developing areas and at the same
 time sell their productions there. Consequently,
 the gap between the developing and developed
 world has been enlarged.

WRITING




 2. Some people think that news media
 is negative for society, what is your
 opinion?

WRITING

 The news media is the only way for the public
to be informed of a variety of useful knowledge in
the information society and there is no substitute
at the moment. In the past, and individual had to
deal with very few things within one day and
therefore it was possible for him to know what
happened around him in person. But nowadays,
with the trend of globalization, he could virtually
do nothing without the news media. For example,
the news stories about the education policies
abroad and the overseas studying experience have
addicted parents and their children to select the
suitable universities before they have not got the
opportunity to visit the country involved.

WRITING



首段引出主题+总论点中间段落分论点1+论证分论点2+论证分论点3+论证末段重申总论点+补充说明

WRITING


末段宗旨：重申总论点和最重要的分论点结构：
 首词（表示总结的关联词）
 +重申总论点
 +补充说明

WRITING

一. 议论类的关联词

 In a nutshell/in sum/all in all/ in conclusion/

 It is an inescapable conclusion that

 When all the factors are examined, we may
 safely come to the conclusion that

 From what has been discussed above, we can see
 that (it is obvious that，personally, I firmly hold
 that）….

WRITING

二. 问题解决类文章的首词或首句（结尾段需要给出建议类型）

1. Nevertheless, numerous solutions to this problem
 may be found.

2. From my point of view, what teenagers are in
 urgent need of is to …

3. To relieve it, I wish to suggest three appropriate
 measures.

WRITING



三.两边倒

1). 总论点+两面性不影响特性
2). 总论点+结合两方面

WRITING

 1).总论点+两面性不影响特性

 There are various kinds of media used for
communicating information, such as the theatre, films,
comics. TV, radio and books. Which do you think is the
most effective? How do you think about it?.......

 In a word, TV has both its strengths and its
weakness. Yet this two-sidedness does not prevent
TV being the most effective of all the media in
society today.

WRITING

2). 总论点+结合两方面

 Surveillance cameras------

 All in all, the best solution is for both sides to
 respect each other’s needs. The shopkeeper should
 place surveillance cameras in such a way that the
 customer do not feel that he or she is being spied
 upon. At the same time, the customer should
 respect the shopkeeper’s concern about theft.

WRITING


四.一边倒


1).总论点+最重要的分论点
2). 总论点+对反面的让步
3). 总论点+否则

WRITING



1) .总论点+最重要的分论点

 Death penalty-----

 Personally, I am an opponent of the death
 penalty. Mistakes could be made which it is not
 possible to rectify(correct). In addition, there is
 no evidence that the death penalty has the effect
 of reducing crime, which is surely the aim of
 punishment.

WRITING


2）总论点+对反面的让步（一边倒）

 Most countries spend a large amount of money on
 weapons to defend themselves, even though they are
 not at war. Those countries should spend that money to
 help their citizens who are poor and disadvantages.
 What is your opinion? ----

 In conclusion, in a world where all people, rich and
 poor, cherish and cry out for peace, those countries
 in question should shift their priority from arms
 buildup to economics development, thus making
 their due contribution to world peace and to the
 well-being of all people. Of course, national defense
 within limits is necessary for all countries, but too
 much of it might as well be counter-productive.

WRITING

3）总论点+否则

 Some people think that, as scientists contribute more
 to the development of our society than other people,
 science students get more financial support from the
 government than other students get. Do you agree or
 disagree? -------

 In sum, the needs of science and arts students for
 higher education should be duly and equally
 addressed by the government. Otherwise not only
 would the world become much drier and duller, but
 society as a whole would develop in an unbalanced
 and distorted manner.

WRITING



五.原因和建议

1) 中间段落只讲原因，最后一段要解决问题：

 I think there are a few ways to deal with the
 problem.

 To make this transitional period go smoothly,
 the following x ways could be applied…

WRITING

2) 中间段落要论述原因和建议

 A:解决问题的重要意义：青少年犯罪问题------
 We must not forget that children are the future of our
 country, so it is an important task for the whole of society
 to pay more attention to their physical and mental
 development.

 B: 不解决问题的重大危害: 城市交通问题----
 In view of the factors listed above, I believe that some
 measures should be taken so as to rein in situation.
 Otherwise, many of today’s prosperous cities may fall
 victim to problems of severe water shortage, land crisis,
 energy scarcity, and-even worse- a more polluted
 environment.

WRITING
